WAW I NEED TO JUMP!
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
This is a game made for the challenge One Map game. (Also it is my first game)
In this game, you will play as Morkar, within the lore of Wings at War.
He chooses to make a deal with the goblins in exchange for the power to nullify the consequences of breaking his pact with the Red Wing.
The game’s main mechanic is figuring out what the puzzle is — and how to solve it.
